title: Text: DET Jerry Lewis ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: How are you?  You doing game stories on Tigers?  5287 Pond Bluff Dr.  West Bloomfield, MI 48323.  Still have me working from home.  Hope you are well
A lot up in the air right now. Between me and you, Colangelo has been trying to crack down on my coverage for a while. My editor does not have much gumption and appears to have given in.
So sorry to hear that.  Hang in there you do good reporting not your fault Tigers have been so bad since you got there.  Team playing better now hope we have baseball for all 60 games
For sure. Pls keep that between us. Stay safe
